tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the knowledge base for pages that match the query. Returns titles, short snippets and stable page ids that can be passed to the fetch tool afterwards.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full content of one page by its stable id. Large pages are split into sections; pass the section cursor from a previous call to continue reading where it stopped.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a new page under the given parent. The body is written in Markdown and converted to blocks on the server; headings, lists, tables, code fences and links are preserved.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Replace one block of an existing page, append blocks after a given block, or move a block to another position. Every call returns the new revision id of the page.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a page or reply inside an existing comment thread. Mentions use the user id form and notify the mentioned person through their usual channel.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the children of a page or a folder in display order. Results are paginated; pass the cursor returned by the previous call to read the next page of children.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move a page to another parent. The page keeps its id, history and comments; links that point to it keep working because they resolve through the stable id.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Move a page to the trash. Pages in the trash can be restored for thirty days; after that they are removed together with their comments and attachments.

tools.name: restore
tools.description: Restore a page from the trash to its previous parent. When the parent no longer exists the page is restored to the top level of the same workspace instead.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Read the revision history of a page. Each entry carries the revision id, the author, the time of the change and a short summary of the blocks that changed.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two revisions of the same page and return the blocks that were added, removed or changed between them, in document order, with their block ids.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a page and optionally its children as Markdown, HTML or PDF. Exports run in the background; the call returns a job id that the status tool can poll.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the status of a background job such as an export or an import. Finished jobs carry a download link that stays valid for one hour after completion.

tools.name: import
tools.description: Import a Markdown or HTML file as a new page under the given parent. Images referenced by relative paths must be uploaded first through the attachment tool.

tools.name: attach
tools.description: Upload a file and attach it to a page. Images are shown inline, other files appear as a download block; the call returns the attachment id and its display url.

tools.name: share
tools.description: Change who can open a page: keep it private, share it with named people or groups, or make it readable by everyone in the workspace who has the link.

tools.name: permissions
tools.description: Read the current sharing settings of a page, including inherited permissions from its parents, so that a change can be reviewed before it is applied.

tools.name: templates
tools.description: List the page templates available in the workspace. A template id can be passed to the create tool to start a new page from that template instead of an empty body.

tools.name: backlinks
tools.description: List the pages that link to the given page, with the block that contains each link, so that references can be reviewed before a page is moved or deleted.

tools.name: recent
tools.description: List the pages the current user opened or edited most recently, newest first, with the time of the last visit and the time of the last edit for each page.

tools.name: favorites
tools.description: List the pages the current user marked as favorites, in the order the user arranged them, together with the workspace each favorite page belongs to.

tools.name: users
tools.description: Look up people in the workspace by name or email and return their user ids, display names and avatars, for use in mentions and in sharing settings.

tools.name: groups
tools.description: List the groups in the workspace with their member counts. Group ids can be used in sharing settings to give every member of the group the same access.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the id, display name and workspace of the account this connection runs as, which helps to explain why a page is or is not visible to the tools.
